# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IterativeTDDRunner | src/agents/iterative_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates the iterative RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple scenarios |
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner.py | Runs one complete TDD cycle with GREEN retries and optional learning loop |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for Python TDD cycles using WorkerAgent and PodmanOrchestrator |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent.py | Generates code for each TDD phase (test, implementation, refactor) via LLM |
| IncrementalPlanner | src/agents/incremental_planner.py | Determines the next test increment by querying the LLM with current context |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src/agents/podman_orchestrator.py | Stateless sidecar execution layer that pulses files into the container and verifies hashes |
| PodmanRunner | src/agents/podman_runner.py | Production ContainerRunner backed by rootless Podman |
| PlaybookManager | src/playbook/manager.py | Manages playbook CRUD, delta updates, semantic deduplication, and token budgets |
| ExperimentLogger | src/storage/experiment_logger.py | Unified logger for TDD and ML experiments with PostgreSQL/SQLite fallback |
| Reflector | src/core/reflector/module.py | Analyzes task outcomes, extracts error patterns, root causes, and key insights |
| Curator | src/core/curator/module.py | Synthesizes reflector insights into actionable playbook delta bullets |
| Generator | src/core/generator/module.py | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM with bullet retrieval and feedback |
| BulletRetriever | src/playbook/retrieval.py | Hybrid retrieval engine for selecting relevant playbook bullets via embeddings and keywords |
| GherkinFeatureBridge | src/agents/gherkin_feature_bridge.py | Parses Gherkin .feature files into FeatureSpec objects |
| RedundancyPreChecker | src/agents/redundancy_checker.py | Pre-checks proposed tests for redundancy before the RED phase |
| TestReviewAgent | src/agents/test_review_agent.py | Validates test quality (structure, naming, assertions, edge cases) before implementation |
| TDDFailureRecorder | src/agents/tdd_failure_recorder.py | Records TDD failures and interventions for self-improvement and playbook updates |
| TDDLessonInjector | src/agents/tdd_lesson_injector.py | Injects TDD lessons into agent prompts based on development phase |
| EnsembleBuildRunner | src/agents/ensemble_build.py | Drives multi-candidate blind build for one feature across multiple models |
| PolyglotTDDRunner | src/agents/polyglot_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates RED→GREEN→REFACTOR across multiple LanguagePods for different languages |
| PodFactory | src/agents/polyglot_tdd_runner.py | Creates LanguagePod instances for a given language identifier |
| GoLanguagePod | src/agents/go_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for Go TDD cycles |
| TypeScriptLanguagePod | src/agents/typescript_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for TypeScript TDD cycles |
| SimulationPod | src/agents/simulation_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for PyBullet-backed simulation TDD cycles |
| SimulationOracle | src/agents/simulation_oracle.py | Runs a controller script against a SimulationScenario inside a sandboxed subprocess |
| ImportFilter | src/agents/import_filter.py | Checks generated code for forbidden imports and builtin calls |
| LLMClient | src/utils/llm_client.py | Unified LLM client supporting multiple providers (OpenRouter, Ollama, etc.) |
| EmbeddingService | src/utils/embedding.py | Local embedding generation using sentence-transformers for bullet similarity |
| ContextMapBuilder | src/utils/context_map.py | Builds AST-based context map from source files for module-aware generation |
| AdaptiveBroker | src/broker/adaptive_broker.py | Routes tasks to best agent based on historical performance and cost-awareness |
| PerformanceAggregator | src/broker/performance_aggregator.py | Aggregates performance metrics from audit trail for agent evaluation |
| AuditStore | src/audit/store.py | Append-only audit event store with hash chain integrity |
| AuditClient | src/audit/client.py | Write-only audit client for emitting events to the audit store |
| BlindEvaluator | src/benchmark/blind_evaluation.py | Scores outputs without knowing which agent produced them |
| ModelAttributionTracker | src/benchmark/model_attribution.py | Tracks OpenRouter model attribution in performance metrics |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Main
    participant IterativeTDDRunner
    participant TDDCycleRunner
    participant PythonLanguagePod
    participant WorkerAgent
    participant PodmanOrchestrator
    participant PodmanRunner
    participant IncrementalPlanner
    participant GherkinFeatureBridge
    participant PlaybookManager
    participant ExperimentLogger
    participant Reflector
    participant Curator
    participant AuditClient

    Main->>IterativeTDDRunner: run_from_feature(feature_path)
    IterativeTDDRunner->>GherkinFeatureBridge: parse(feature_path)
    GherkinFeatureBridge-->>IterativeTDDRunner: FeatureSpec
    loop for each scenario or until complete
        IterativeTDDRunner->>IncrementalPlanner: next_increment(requirement, cycle)
        IncrementalPlanner-->>IterativeTDDRunner: TestIncrement
        IterativeTDDRunner->>TDDCycleRunner: run(spec)
        activate TDDCycleRunner
        TDDCycleRunner->>PythonLanguagePod: run_red(spec)
        activate PythonLanguagePod
        PythonLanguagePod->>WorkerAgent: generate_test(spec)
        WorkerAgent-->>PythonLanguagePod: test_code
        PythonLanguagePod->>PodmanOrchestrator: pulse(files)
        PodmanOrchestrator->>PodmanRunner: send_pulse(files)
        PodmanRunner-->>PodmanOrchestrator: PulseResult
        PodmanOrchestrator-->>PythonLanguagePod: PhaseResult
        PythonLanguagePod-->>TDDCycleRunner: red_result
        deactivate PythonLanguagePod
        alt RED aborted or failed
            TDDCycleRunner-->>IterativeTDDRunner: CycleResult(success=False)
        else RED passed
            loop max_green_attempts
                TDDCycleRunner->>PythonLanguagePod: run_green(spec)
                activate PythonLanguagePod
                PythonLanguagePod->>WorkerAgent: generate_implementation(spec)
                WorkerAgent-->>PythonLanguagePod: impl_code
                PythonLanguagePod->>PodmanOrchestrator: pulse(files)
                PodmanOrchestrator->>PodmanRunner: send_pulse(files)
                PodmanRunner-->>PodmanOrchestrator: PulseResult
                PodmanOrchestrator-->>PythonLanguagePod: PhaseResult
                PythonLanguagePod-->>TDDCycleRunner: green_result
                deactivate PythonLanguagePod
                alt green passed
                    break
                else green failed and not abort
                    Note right of TDDCycleRunner: retry with error feedback
                end
            end
            alt green passed
                TDDCycleRunner->>PythonLanguagePod: run_refactor(spec)
                activate PythonLanguagePod
                PythonLanguagePod->>WorkerAgent: generate_refactor(spec)
                WorkerAgent-->>PythonLanguagePod: refactored_code
                PythonLanguagePod->>PodmanOrchestrator: pulse(files)
                PodmanOrchestrator->>PodmanRunner: send_pulse(files)
                PodmanRunner-->>PodmanOrchestrator: PulseResult
                PodmanOrchestrator-->>PythonLanguagePod: PhaseResult
                PythonLanguagePod-->>TDDCycleRunner: refactor_result
                deactivate PythonLanguagePod
                TDDCycleRunner->>Reflector: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
                Reflector-->>TDDCycleRunner: ReflectorOutput
                TDDCycleRunner->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
                Curator->>PlaybookManager: apply_delta(delta_bullets)
                PlaybookManager-->>Curator: added_bullets
                Curator-->>TDDCycleRunner: CuratorOutput
                TDDCycleRunner->>ExperimentLogger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
                TDDCycleRunner->>AuditClient: emit_simple(...)
                TDDCycleRunner-->>IterativeTDDRunner: CycleResult(success=True)
            else green failed
                TDDCycleRunner-->>IterativeTDDRunner: CycleResult(success=False)
            end
        end
        deactivate TDDCycleRunner
        IterativeTDDRunner->>ExperimentLogger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
        IterativeTDDRunner->>AuditClient: emit_simple(...)
    end
    IterativeTDDRunner-->>Main: IterativeResult
```
